title: docs: update README — 2026-09-14
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt: Daily README update: Latest News and star history. Recent Apps is refreshed when an app is published.

gist.headline: The garden sign is fresh
gist.blurb: The README got its daily tending: latest hive news and the star-history chart are current again. Even the little public noticeboard deserves water.
gist.summary: Refreshed the README’s Latest News section and light/dark GitHub star-history assets for the 2026-09-14 daily update.
gist.impact: Visitors to the repository now see current project news and an up-to-date star-growth chart in both light and dark themes.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli tending a cozy open-source garden noticeboard shaped like a README document, with a gently rising star chart made of tiny pixel stars. Polli uses a tiny librarian cap and watering can to refresh the board while code-plants and flowers grow around it; a small CRT monitor can display the updated news lines.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of the cute Polli bee mascot, with a tiny librarian cap, watering a garden noticeboard shaped like an open README while a row of small pixel stars climbs upward on a chart; a friendly CRT monitor shows a few fresh news lines beside blooming code-plants. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized and warmly tending the scene. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, subtle CRT glow, pixel-font text: 'LATEST NEWS', nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
